topic: assistant-exploration-api round-3: reorder has updateView's fail-closed bug
lesson: ONE defect, reported by quality and performance as three blockers. pins.service.ts reorder commits its position updates inside a db.transaction and only THEN calls listRows, which is where re-authorization and the batched refusal audit happen - so if that refusal audit throws, the reorder has already committed. This is exactly the ordering bug fixed in updateView last round; reorder was missed. The fix is mechanical and needs no extra query: the owned rows are ALREADY selected at pins.service.ts:78 for the ownership check. Compute selectionStatus over those rows, write the batched refusal audit BEFORE entering the transaction, then commit the position updates, then return. Do not add a second SELECT, and keep the existing ownership validation and its BadRequestException exactly as they are - t-aea-c5 requires the audit BEFORE the write on every route, fail-closed.
